archiveTitle: Daily Brief | Grand Theft Auto VI reviews open at a provisional Metacritic 99

entries.headline: Grand Theft Auto VI reviews open with a provisional Metacritic score of 99
entries.summary: Grand Theft Auto VI reviews are live. AUTOMATON reports a provisional Metacritic score of 99 from 147 critic reviews, the highest score recorded for a 2026 game at that snapshot.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report provides a time-bounded Metacritic snapshot. The score is presented as provisional because additional reviews can change it.
entries.timeNote: Published at 21:30 Beijing time on November 18, inside the fixed window.

entries.headline: Phonopolis wins two honors at the DevGAMM Awards 2026
entries.summary: The third DevGAMM Awards recognized 70 nominated games from 25 countries across 17 categories. Phonopolis won both the Grand Prize and Excellence in Visual Art.
entries.verification: The opened IGN report identifies the event scale and the two Phonopolis awards. Other winners not visible in the packet are not added.
entries.timeNote: Published at 04:00 Beijing time on November 19, inside the fixed window.

entries.headline: Rockstar says Grand Theft Auto VI targets 30fps on every supported console
entries.summary: Rockstar development head Rob Nelson told IGN that targeting 60fps would require too many fundamental compromises. The game targets 30fps across its supported consoles, including PS5 Pro.
entries.verification: The opened IGN report includes Nelson’s direct explanation. No claim is made about a future PC version.
entries.timeNote: Published at 20:50 Beijing time on November 18, inside the fixed window.

entries.headline: PS5 players need system software 26.07-14.23.00 for Grand Theft Auto VI
entries.summary: PlayStation support said PS5 players must install system software 26.07-14.23.00 before playing Grand Theft Auto VI and recommended updating before the November 19 midnight launch.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report embeds and relays the PlayStation support notices for the United States and Japan.
entries.timeNote: Published at 11:45 Beijing time on November 18, inside the fixed window.
entries.regionLabel: Japan and United States notice regions

entries.headline: Videogame Automation Engineer launches March 4, 2027
entries.summary: Prof. Scherer announced Videogame Automation Engineer for PC via Steam. Players connect sensors, logic circuits, and controllers to automate a variety of minigames.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report attributes the announcement to Prof. Scherer and confirms the platform, date, and core mechanics.
entries.timeNote: Published at 14:51 Beijing time on November 18, inside the fixed window.

entries.headline: CRYMELIGHT resets its Steam launch for December 1
entries.summary: FuRyu now plans to release the delayed Steam version of CRYMELIGHT on December 1. The PS5 and Nintendo Switch 2 versions launched on November 5.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report embeds FuRyu’s notice and treats December 1 as the current planned date.
entries.timeNote: Published at 17:36 Beijing time on November 18, inside the fixed window.

entries.headline: Coral Island for Nintendo Switch 2 and update 1.4 launch December 7
entries.summary: Coral Island comes to Nintendo Switch 2 on December 7 alongside the free 1.4 Kids Grow Up update. The version supports multiplayer for up to four players and cross-play.
entries.verification: The opened Gematsu report attributes the announcement to Balor Games and Stairway Games and specifies the date, platform, and update scope.
entries.timeNote: Published at 02:11 Beijing time on November 19, inside the fixed window.

entries.headline: Nobunaga’s Ambition: Hishou cancels its original Switch version
entries.summary: Koei Tecmo and Kou Shibusawa canceled the previously announced Nintendo Switch version. The game remains planned for PS5, Nintendo Switch 2, and Steam in Japan and Asia this winter.
entries.verification: The opened Gematsu report attributes the cancellation to the publisher and developer and identifies the remaining platforms.
entries.timeNote: Published at 17:30 Beijing time on November 18, inside the fixed window.

entries.headline: Phasmophobia’s Resonance update launches November 24
entries.summary: Kinetic Games will release the Resonance update on November 24, adding equipment including the Dowsing Rod and moving the game to Unity 6.
entries.verification: The opened 4Gamer report attributes the announcement to Kinetic Games and identifies the date and headline changes.
entries.timeNote: Published at 20:38 Beijing time on November 18, inside the fixed window.

entries.headline: Prison stealth-horror game PROCEDURE ZERO launches
entries.summary: DELANIVO GAMES released PROCEDURE ZERO on November 18. The first-person stealth-action horror game sends players into a prison where inmates have disappeared.
entries.verification: The opened 4Gamer report confirms the developer, date, and core premise. Platforms omitted from the visible snapshot are not inferred.
entries.timeNote: Published at 14:03 Beijing time on November 18, inside the fixed window.

entries.headline: ReStory announces its paid Commodore DLC
entries.summary: tinyBuild and Mandragora announced a paid Commodore DLC for ReStory. It adds licensed devices including the Commodore 64, plus new characters and story content, in the first quarter of 2027.
entries.verification: The opened Denfaminicogamer report embeds the announcement and identifies the DLC scope and release window.
entries.timeNote: Published at 17:03 Beijing time on November 18, inside the fixed window.

entries.headline: Volvy’s Adventure: Reslimed launches alongside Grand Theft Auto VI with a parody trailer
entries.summary: Devolver Digital is releasing Volvy’s Adventure: Reslimed on November 19 and promoted it with a shot-by-shot recreation of the Grand Theft Auto VI launch trailer.
entries.verification: The opened PC Gamer report identifies the release timing and describes the public trailer. Unstated platforms and pricing are not inferred.
entries.timeNote: Published at 06:12 Beijing time on November 19, inside the fixed window.

entries.headline: The Ascent receives its first major patch in roughly four years
entries.summary: Neon Giant released the Legacy Patch on November 19 for PC, PS5, PS4, and Xbox Series X|S, addressing numerous issues and adding HDR support. Xbox One does not receive the patch. The Switch 2 Ultimate Edition includes the fixes at its December 3 launch.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON hands-on report identifies the patch, HDR support, and its relationship to the Switch 2 edition.
entries.timeNote: Published at 10:00 Beijing time on November 19, ten minutes before the cutoff.

entries.headline: Riot Games raises Japanese in-game currency prices on December 9
entries.summary: Riot Games will adjust in-game currency prices in Japan at 01:00 local time on December 9. Average increases are about 9% for League of Legends and Teamfight Tactics, 24% for VALORANT on PC and for Legends of Runeterra, and 10% for Wild Rift. VALORANT console prices are unchanged.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report attributes the change to Riot Games and states that exact increases vary by product and platform.
entries.timeNote: Published at 10:36 Beijing time on November 18, inside the fixed window.

entries.headline: Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 lead writer Jennifer Svedberg-Yen leaves Sandfall
entries.summary: Jennifer Svedberg-Yen has left Sandfall for cross-studio narrative consulting and is setting up a fund intended to support narrative design and emerging writing talent.
entries.verification: The opened IGN report relays Svedberg-Yen’s comments to GamesBeat. No internal reason for her departure is inferred.
entries.timeNote: Published at 00:35 Beijing time on November 19, inside the fixed window.
